title: Loud Places at Dawn
description: A warm, gospel-tinged house roller at 122 BPM: a soulful felt-piano chord riff stabs over a steady four-on-the-floor TR606 kick, building to a hands-in-the-air peak, dropping into a reverbless delay-soaked valley, then surging back for a second, brighter climax before the kit strips away.
code:
setcpm(122/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.92),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>/2").s("piano").lpf(900).room(0.45).gain(0.56)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.0),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.5).cut(1),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").lpf(1500).room(0.4).gain(0.58)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4))
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.08),
    s("~ cp").gain(0.62).room(0.3),
    s("hh*3").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.46).cut(1).swingBy(0.12, 8),
    s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.4),
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>").s("jvbass").lpf(700).shape(0.3).gain(0.74),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").lpf(2200).room(0.35).gain(0.6)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.42))
      .every(8, x => x.add(note("<0 5>")))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.7),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3]>/2").s("piano").lpf(1300).delay(".55:.166:.6").gain(0.6)
      .off(0.25, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.34))
  )],
  [40, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.12),
    s("~ cp").gain(0.66).delay(".4:.125:.4"),
    s("hh(7,8)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.5).cut(1).swingBy(0.1, 8),
    s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.44),
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>").s("jvbass").lpf("<800 1100>/4").shape(0.34).gain(0.76),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").lpf(2800).room(0.3).gain(0.62)
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.46))
      .sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.add(note(7)))
      .every(8, x => x.add(note("<0 7 5 12>")))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.84),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>/2").s("piano").lpf(1100).delay(".5:.166:.55").gain(0.56)
      .off(0.25, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.32))
  )]
)
